summary: Fair's own pages: 2026 $40/day per unit (water/electric) confirmed, $800/30 days; 470 sites (120 full hookup, 350 W/E) confirmed; water/sewer confirmed. Booking now an online application form (url added), invoice on acceptance, no refunds; office phone 906-786-2192 matches. Not fair-week-only: a 'General Non-Fair' nightly rate is sold, and the grounds stay open for camping during the fair (weekly $300 only, Aug 15-23). No season or amperage stated.
